g.text: Coverage architecture across all template and regime cells
A: future hospital averaged over realizations B: joint future realization and hospital
Dashed outline: <0.90. Solid outline: >0.99. Descriptive concentration thresholds,
not inferential calibration cutoffs. Exact values: Table S8 and Figure 4 source data.
